title: Account Manager - Enterprise
description:
WHAT IS SPADE?

Financial institutions process billions of transactions every day across cards, ACH, wires, and third party aggregators. But most of that data is difficult to use. Descriptions are inconsistent, merchant names don’t match, and categories vary by payment type.

Spade is a data and AI platform that turns messy transaction strings into structured, verified records — and gives teams the tools to act on it across authorization, attribution, analytics, and AI initiatives. Spade leads the market in terms of merchant coverage, matching accuracy, geolocation data, and speed of transaction enrichment. Customers such as, FIS, Bilt, Mercury, Stripe, alongside many other leaders in fintech and financial services, trust Spade's data to enable personalized rewards programs, accurate applied spending rules, precise analytics requests, and innovative AI-powered features.

Spade is a fast growing, Series B company backed by industry experts and top tier investors (including Oak HC/FT, a16z, Flourish Ventures, Y-Combinator, and Gradient Ventures). We’re a lean and execution-oriented hybrid team, passionate about building exceptional products for our growing customer base. We care deeply about diversity of background, experience, and opinion. We value empathy, curiosity, and passion, and strive to create an environment where individuals have autonomy and the ability to take ownership over their work.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As an Account Manager at Spade, you'll contribute directly to Spade’s revenue growth by owning the strategic relationships and growth trajectory for our enterprise customers. You'll manage implementations, drive product adoption and expansion, and build deep partnerships with the world’s leading financial institutions.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

- Own 5-10 major enterprise customer relationships ($2-5MM total ARR) from signature through renewal and expansion, serving as primary point of contact and trusted advisor

- Build VP and C-suite relationships at each customer — mapping their roadmap, org, and strategic priorities — and run the QBRs, executive briefings, and onsites that move relationships forward

- Lead renewals and multi-year pricing negotiations, including over-utilization, scope changes, and contract restructures, structuring complex deals across legal, procurement, and technical teams on both sides

- Drive expansion by spotting opportunities and selling customers into new Spade products, owning the full deal cycle from discovery to close

- Act as the customer's voice internally — partnering with engineering, product, and SEs on technical investigations, and translating findings and feedback into prioritized roadmap asks and VOC briefs

- Partner with Sales pre-signature and Solutions Engineering post-signature to ensure clean handoffs and successful implementations on technically complex accounts

WHAT EXPERIENCE, SKILLS, AND QUALIFICATIONS ARE NECESSARY?

MUST HAVE:

- 7+ years of experience, including 5+ years of account management or account executive experience for a technical product carrying a quota with responsibility for account growth, upsells, and renewals

- Proven ownership of commercial outcomes (quota, NRR target, or revenue retention number) on a book of enterprise accounts, ideally in the $500K-$2M ACV range per contract

- Experience owning enterprise deals and relationships, partnering with executive level stakeholders, and leading multi-year, multi-product enterprise contract negotiations, including MSA/procurement/legal terms

- Comfort using AI, automation, and self-built workflows to scale yourself

- Based in NYC with ability to work out of our Flatiron office at least 2 days/week

NICE TO HAVE:

- Experience with transaction or payments data

- Experience with API or data products

- Experience building post-sales playbooks, SOPs, or operating frameworks from scratch

title: Founding Customer Success Manager - US - AI health-tech
description:
WHY VOIZE? BECAUSE WE’RE MORE THAN JUST A JOB!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to admin work that pulls nurses away from what matters most: people.

We’re changing that by building the AI companion that frees nurses from admin, giving them back up to 30% of time. We don’t replace humans - we support and amplify their impact. Today, 1,500+ care facilities trust voize, and over 150,000 nurses rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs.

As a fast-growing team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 YOUR MISSION: SCALE ROLLOUTS FROM PILOT TO 100+ BUILDINGS

As our Founding Customer Success Manager – US (NYC-based), you'll own customer success across our US rollouts, from smaller pilots today to, over time, our largest and most complex accounts: enterprise operators running 100+ buildings and 100,000+ nurses. You'll take organizations from a first pilot of 2-4 buildings through a full-scale rollout, working with stakeholders at every level, from the C-suite down to individual building leadership. There is no playbook yet for scaling at this range. You'll build it.

🚀 YOUR DAILY BUSINESS – NO TWO DAYS ARE ALIKE

- Own the rollout, start to finish: manage the full journey of our accounts, from smaller pilot rollouts today to full deployments across 100+ buildings and 100,000+ nurses for our largest enterprise operators.

- Manage stakeholders at every level: build trust and alignment across the entire customer organization, from C-level sponsors to regional leadership to individual building administrators and directors of nursing.

- Build the playbook from scratch: define the processes, adoption cadence, health metrics, and escalation paths for scaling accounts at this range, since nothing like it exists yet at voize.

- Drive adoption at scale: get nurses across dozens of buildings actively using voize day to day, without relying on 1:1 hand-holding at every site.

- Track health and manage risk across a huge footprint: build the framework for spotting and resolving problems early, across a large, distributed organization.

- Do it yourself: there's no dedicated team yet, so you'll own project management, executive reporting, on-site support, and coordination with Customer Training, Sales, Product, and Support directly.

🤝 YOUR SKILLSET – WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

- Direct experience scaling a customer success or implementation motion from a small pilot to 100+ locations and tens of thousands of end users, ideally at a hypergrowth B2B SaaS company.

- You've lived through hypergrowth yourself and understand firsthand what changes (process, stakeholders, complexity) as an account grows from a handful of sites to over 100.

- Proven ability to manage multi-layered stakeholder relationships, from C-level sponsors to on-site building leadership, keeping them aligned through a long, complex rollout.

- High agency and a true builder mindset: you create structure and process from zero, with no existing playbook or team to lean on.

- Strong program and project management skills to coordinate rollouts across dozens of sites at once.

- A data-driven mindset, using adoption and health metrics to prioritize your work and prove value to enterprise stakeholders.

- Willingness to travel to customer sites across the US.

- Healthcare, senior care, or health-tech background is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

🌱 GROWING TOGETHER - WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT VOIZE

- We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people
